question: For every stadium, show its name and the number of concerts held there, including stadiums with none.
reference_sql: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) FROM stadium AS s LEFT JOIN concert AS c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
candidate_sql:
SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium AS s
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
    ON c.Stadium_ID = CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name;
